description:
Score a page against the four signals Google added to the Lighthouse "Agentic Browsing" category in May 2026: presence of an llms.txt, WebMCP integration, accessibility-tree integrity, and layout stability. Returns an overall 0-100 score, a letter grade, and a per-factor breakdown.

Read-only. One HTTP GET for the page plus one for /llms.txt (skip with check_llms_txt=false). Pass `html` instead of `url` to score markup offline (llms.txt is then treated as absent).

Deterministic, rule-based heuristics over the fetched HTML; no LLM and no headless render required. This approximates Lighthouse's runtime signals from static markup - it does not execute Lighthouse.

When to use: checking whether a site is ready for AI agents / agentic browsers, or tracking the new Lighthouse Agentic Browsing category. For citation-eligibility of content, use `score_citation_worthiness`; for a full page audit, use `audit_page`.

check_llms_txt.description: If true (default), probe /llms.txt for the host to score the llms.txt factor. Set false to skip that extra HTTP GET.

html.description: Raw HTML to score offline without fetching. Either this OR `url` is required. llms.txt is treated as absent in this mode.

render.description: Rendering mode for `url`. `static` (default) reads raw HTML; `headless` runs Playwright Chromium (adds 3-10s; requires `playwright-core`). Ignored when `html` is used.

respect_robots.description: If true (default), respect robots.txt when fetching `url`. Ignored when `html` is used.

url.description: Public URL to fetch and score. Either this OR `html` is required.

name: score_agentic_browsing

factors.description: The four Lighthouse Agentic Browsing signals, scored 0-100 each.

detail.description: One-line description of what was measured.

category.description: Finding category - which AI-SEO dimension it relates to.

estimated_impact.description: Estimated impact on AI citation probability when resolved.

failure_signal.description: Falsifiability: the observable signal that would prove the fix did NOT work.

leading_indicator.description: Falsifiability: the leading indicator to monitor to confirm the fix is landing.

severity.description: Triage priority: critical blocks AI citation, warning hurts probability, info is nice-to-have.

where.description: Location of the issue (CSS selector, JSON-LD path, robots.txt line, or 'page-level').

grade.description: Letter grade derived from the numeric score.

score.description: Weighted 0-100 Agentic Browsing score (accessibility 40%, layout 35%, webmcp 15%, llms.txt 10%).

url.description: The URL scored (null when scoring raw html).

title: Score Agentic Browsing readiness
